releases.name: BatchMath v12.9.B (review build)
releases.body:
Review build for teacher testing. Not deployed: production `main` is unchanged (v12.8.Y, 26ec4f1).
Not approved: automated QA passed, and the build awaits the teacher's review. The v12.9.A prerelease is unchanged.

Source: branch `claude/v12.9b-unit6-teacher-corrections`, commit ca4fb4aa463ba43a8d66dc3d5ad91c9300343fbb.

Unit 6 teacher-testing corrections to v12.9.A; everything else is as in v12.9.A.
- Explanations: no redundant parentheses or written coefficients of 1, signed-area arithmetic shown, round only the final answer; compact area graphs.
- Area: setups with respect to x, y, either or both; setup only or with the value; graphs in explanations; a Choosing dx or dy Practice Type with typed integrals.
- Area in terms of y: a graph in every explanation, mixed y = f(x) and x = g(y) forms, no supplied bounds the curves define.
- Piecewise integrals: typed exact answers; the explanation splits the integral and evaluates each piece.
- Cross sections: Show Graph / Hide Graph in non-calculator questions; the base with one slice and the cross section in the explanation; half perpendicular to each axis.
- Solids: the graph in about half the non-calculator questions with the axis inside the frame; R and r or the shell radius and height drawn in the explanation; no question graph on calculator problems; more calculator axes; a two-axis calculator problem.
- Integral setups are graded by their structure, not only their value: other methods or variables are accepted where the problem lists them, and a setup that only has the right value is refused.
- Review Practice Types renamed: Area & Volume — Multi-Part Practice; Graph Analysis & Accumulation — Multi-Part Practice (labels only).
- MathLive is not part of this build (separate migration); see docs/v12.9.B-unit6-mathlive-handoff.md.

See docs/v12.9.B-revisions.md (changes, distributions, teacher checklist, limitations) and docs/v12.9.B-progress.md (commits, checks). Serve the extracted folder with `py -m http.server 8000`.
